h1: Custom Plastic Jackets for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom plastic jackets for promotions or safety. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Plastic jackets offer a lightweight, waterproof layer ideal for outdoor events, construction sites, or rainy-day giveaways. Unlike fabric jackets, plastic materials like PVC or PEVA provide full wind and water resistance at a lower cost per unit, making them a practical choice for large promotional campaigns or safety gear. Decorate with screen printing or heat transfer logos for high-visibility branding that stands up to wet conditions.
